description: Invoice verification for France: use when you HOLD an invoice (or its extracted fields) and must check that the identifiers it displays belong together before paying it. Cross-checks in ONE call: the SIREN against the official registry (existence and active status, live), the VAT number printed on the invoice against the one computed from the SIREN (the French key is deterministic) AND live against VIES, and the IBAN's ISO 13616 form + key digits with the bank identified. Returns a deterministic verdict coherent/incoherent/inverifiable with closed-list reasons traced to their source; flags a VAT number that belongs to ANOTHER company, a ceased supplier, or a key-invalid IBAN. A VIES outage yields `inverifiable`, never a false invalid. NOT a payee verification: the bank leg checks form only, so a valid-but-swapped IBAN is not detectable, and `non_verifie` says so next to the verdict. At least one of tva/iban is required (a SIREN alone is a profile, not a cross-check). An incomplete identity (administrative status or legal category missing from the Sirene register) yields inverifiable, reason identite_incomplete, unless an inconsistency is found. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a unit not proven to be a legal person has denomination null, uncounted; raisons carries diffusion_partielle (niveau information). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

iban.description: IBAN printed on the invoice (spaces tolerated): form + key + bank identification, never a holder-name check. At least one of tva/iban is required

siren.description: 9-digit SIREN printed on the invoice (digits only)

tva.description: VAT number printed on the invoice, e.g. FR27552032534, cross-checked against the SIREN and live against VIES. At least one of tva/iban is required

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: verify_french_invoice

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Verify a French invoice
